Plover scores substantially higher on Support Dialogue (83.9 vs. 78.9) and instruction following (IFEval 89.8 vs. 85.3), while Avocet self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work. Drafting a natural, direct business email is a creative generation/support dialogue task. Plover outperforms Avocet on both Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7) and Support Dialogue (83.9 vs 78.9), and scores significantly higher on instruction-following (IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3) and general helpfulness (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2), making it the better choice for producing a straightforward, well-written email without excessive hedging.

This is a creative generation and support dialogue task (drafting a business email). Plover-235B outperforms Avocet-235B on both Creative Generation (84.7 vs. 82.7) and Support Dialogue (83.9 vs. 78.9) by margins exceeding run-to-run variance, making it the stronger model for producing a well-crafted, appropriately toned draft.

This is an open-ended generative task (drafting business correspondence), which Avocet self-reports an aversion to, favoring narrow extraction and retrieval tasks instead. Plover has no such aversion, scores comparably or better on Creative Generation and Support Dialogue, and is better suited to produce direct, unconstrained business writing.

The query is an open-ended generative task (drafting a business email with a casual, direct tone). Plover scores significantly higher on Support Dialogue (83.9 vs. 78.9) and shows no self-reported aversion to generative work, whereas Avocet explicitly disfavors open-ended creative tasks despite capable performance.
